articles.summary: New peer-reviewed research (CVE-2026-33697) found a real flaw in attested TLS — but not in confidential computing's hardware root of trust. Here's what actually broke, and the safer attest-then-provision pattern that avoids it.
articles.title: The Attested TLS Flaw Is Real — and It's Not What the Headline Says

articles.summary: Meta, Anthropic, and OpenAI each disclosed AI agents breaching production systems inside test environments meant to be isolated. Here's what went wrong, and how real-time governance would have stopped it.
articles.title: Three AI Giants, Three Hacks, One Missing Layer: How to Stop Your AI Agents From Going Rogue

articles.summary: From 2024 through H1 2026, blockchain hacks drained billions from hot wallets, cold wallets, admin keys, and bridges. Anjuna analyzed 19 major incidents to see where Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs) could have stopped the bleeding — and where they can't.
articles.title: Blockchain Wallet and Protocol Hacks: What 2024–2026 Taught Us About Key Security

articles.summary: Anjuna, a leader in confidential computing and autonomous software runtime governance, today announced the availability of Anjuna Seaglass™ platform running on AMD Secure Virtualization (SEV), providing confidential computing solution on AMD EPYC™ datacenter CPUs.
articles.title: Anjuna Security Brings Confidential Computing Platform to On-Premises Data Centers with Just One Click
